optimizedCv.targetRoleTitle: Embedded Software Engineer, Charging Station Firmware
professionalSummary: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to a fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
Watched the charging session success rate on the fleet dashboard after each release wave and held the field on-call for station faults raised by the operations centre.
Coordinated the rollout waves for each release with the operations centre, recording responsibilities in the release ticket.
Tested each firmware version on the hardware-in-the-loop rig before release, with the rig test record attached to the release ticket.
Wrote the release notes for each version, listing known limitations on older station models and hand‑over conditions for field technicians.
experienceHighlights: Released fourteen firmware versions OTA to 3,200 stations (src_6590ed9698e2).
Watched session success rates post‑release and handled October 2023 fleet‑wide fault on-call (src_85eb58451c02).
Coordinated rollout waves and documented responsibility boundaries in release tickets (src_9ed5b2fbd466).
Performed HIL testing with documented rig test records for each version (src_ff04444d49d6).
Authored release notes detailing limitations and hand‑over conditions (src_b76fc0a3139d).
projectsAndWorkSamples: Release tickets for the last five versions with rig test records and wave plans; operations incident log for October 2023 fault (src_9771aeadf821).
optimizedCv.evidenceBoundary: The provided resume and work samples establish the candidate’s experience with OTA firmware releases, HIL testing, release notes, and incident handling for a fleet of public charging stations. No additional claims beyond those documented are made.

evidence.text: Released fourteen firmware versions over the air to the installed fleet of about 3,200 public charging stations between 2022 and 2025, each in rollout waves agreed with the operations centre and each under a release ticket in my name.
